items.name: Masterwork
items.description: RuneScape 3 masterwork equipment, organised item-by-item following RS Wiki craft recipes. Except for 529 apex hides and approximately 115 raw Havenhythe meat/sinew equivalents, all counters start at zero AS UNRECORDED PLACEHOLDERS, not verified bank quantities. Track stages carefully: processed intermediates and raw inputs represent the SAME resources. Additional sets are independent goals. Main index: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_equipment

children.name: Ranged armour & cape
children.description: Item-first Masterwork ranged tree: five T100 armour pieces with full nested leather, plate and sinew recipes, plus the cape and Chinskin prerequisite. Masterwork sinew → Apex sinew from giant kebbit/chinchompa meat + ordinary sinew from raw meat + regular thread. Shared existing banked supplies: 529/504 Apex hides and ~115/262 combined Havenhythe meat/Apex sinew equivalents, never multiplied into piece inventory. Crafting requires 110 Crafting and Chinskin. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged armour
children.description: Five-item T100 armour set; each piece has its own ingredient tree. Total for the five pieces: 20 monochromatic +9 elasticated +1 chromatic leather, 12 ethereal plates, 1,200 Masterwork sinew and 5 Algarum thread. Cape is additional. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment
